description:
Learn the stock market, F&O trading and personal finance in 45-second animated Shorts. SEBI found 93% of F&O traders lost money in 3 years. The 7% Club explains why, and what the 7% do differently.

What you'll learn:
• Trading psychology: revenge trading, FOMO, stop-loss mistakes
• Option trading basics: time decay, leverage, expiry-day risk
• Investing in India: SIP, mutual funds, index funds, compounding
• Money traps: credit cards, EMIs, BNPL, lifestyle inflation
• Scam red flags: Telegram tips, fake profit screenshots, "guaranteed returns"
• Tax basics: new tax regime, STCG vs LTCG

New Shorts daily at 8:30 AM and 7:30 PM IST.
📌 Educational content only. Not SEBI-registered. Not investment advice.

trading-psychology.title: Trading Psychology: Why 93% Lose
trading-psychology.description: Revenge trading, FOMO, moving stop-losses and the other habits that make most traders lose money, in 45-second Shorts. Educational only, not investment advice.

investing-india.description: SIP, compounding, index funds, expense ratios and goal planning for Indian investors in 45-second Shorts. Educational only, not investment advice.

money-traps.description: Credit card minimum due, no-cost EMI, buy now pay later and lifestyle inflation explained in 45-second Shorts.
